issues.explanation: No change to the entity.members route is in the diff, so the required route-level manager gate cannot be verified; only the Livewire mount authorize is shown.
Server-context/draft state (selectedMembershipId, memberRole, confirmingRemoval) is client-writable instead of locked; tampering is mitigated by scoped queries plus authorize, so impact is limited.
User-input properties use inline validate() rules only; the project pattern of #[Validate] attributes (and #[Locked] for server context) is not followed.
Domain writes happen directly in Livewire actions rather than through app/Actions/* classes required by conventions (task-driven, but still a deviation).
Extra public endpoint closeMember is not in the contract; it is a sensible modal helper but strictly out of contract.

conventions.evidence: Docs/CHANGELOG/schema updated and audit logging kept, but no #[Validate] attributes (Members.php:76-88 uses inline validate at :106-109, :240-242), selectedMembershipId not #[Locked] (:84), and writes bypass app/Actions/* (:142-170, PendingInvites.php:391-407).

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (selectedMembership, managerCount, isUniqueViolation at Members.php:323-343); consistent naming; no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: Invites table/model/factory/mail/pending flow/members modals all present (migration :677-688; EntityInvite.php:569-612; EntityInviteMail.php:491-508; Members.php:98-184,205-309; PendingInvites.php:373-434; blades switcher/create-entity/pending-invites/members). Route-level members gate has no diff evidence; diff tail is truncated mid-test.

scope.evidence: Diff is invite/members feature plus in-scope manager-only nav/dashboard gates and docs; no unrelated features. Only tiny extras: closeMember, self-removal redirect (Members.php:304-308), deleteWhenMissingModels.

security.evidence: Every action authorizes (Members.php:100,188,207,229,269; PendingInvites authorizeInvitee :457-460), inputs validated server-side (:106-109, :240-242), scoped findOrFail, firstOrCreate plus lockForUpdate, RateLimiter (:132-140, :168), {{ }} escaping, deliberate $fillable. Gap is only missing #[Locked] on server-context IDs.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses UserRole::manageable(), scopes pending()/forEmail(), mail theme and x-input; helpers managerCount/selectedMembership avoid duplication; no new service layers.

tests.evidence: New Pest suites InvitesTest.php and MembersTest.php cover normalization, expiry, cascade, case-insensitive list, accept/decline incl. idempotent/expired/duplicate/stranger/unverified, onboarding/switcher rendering, mail locales, invite validation/pending/expired-replace/race/rate-limit/unauthorized-cancel/foreign-modal/draft/saveRole/confirmation-modal; diff tail truncated so last test not fully verifiable.

review.summary: Invite-only membership is implemented end to end with good tests and security hygiene, but the required route-level manager gate has no diff evidence and Livewire state misses #[Validate]/#[Locked] attributes, so it needs small changes before merging.
